canvas_256_offset.meaning: point (x, y) of the normal 256x256 canvas = (24+x, 64+y) here; draw this frame at (pet_x - 24, pet_y - 64) where (pet_x, pet_y) is the top-left of the normal 256 frame -> no position jump

ds_bamboo_copter_takeoff.notes: take-off (one-shot): idle -> takes out the copter (1) -> puts it on the head (2), propeller spins up -> lift-off (3) -> rises to the hover height -> hover pose (5); then play ds_bamboo_copter_hover from frame 0

ds_bamboo_copter_hover.notes: hover loop 0-11 (5, arms spread): gentle bob 48 +- 3 px above the ground, propeller spinning

ds_bamboo_copter_fly_right.notes: fly right loop 0-11 (key 4 as drawn: face turned right, hair / tail trailing left) + speed lines

ds_bamboo_copter_to_fly_right.notes: transition into fly right (2 frames, squash pop sy 0.92 -> 1.04): play after frame 11 of hover / fly_left, then fly_right from frame 2

ds_bamboo_copter_to_hover.notes: transition into hover (2 frames, squash pop): play after frame 11 of fly_left / fly_right, then hover from frame 2

ds_bamboo_copter_land.notes: landing (one-shot): play after hover frame 11; descends -> squat landing (6) with squash + dust, propeller spins down -> stands up (2) -> takes the copter off (1) -> idle

ds_bamboo_copter_fly_left.notes: fly left loop 0-11 = pixel mirror of ds_bamboo_copter_fly_right

ds_bamboo_copter_to_fly_left.notes: transition into fly left (mirror of to_fly_right): play after frame 11 of hover / fly_right, then fly_left from frame 2

ds_bamboo_copter.shows: takeoff -> hover 0-11 -> to_fly_left, fly_left 2-11, 0-11 -> to_fly_right, fly_right 2-11, 0-11 -> to_hover, hover 2-11 -> land
